definitions.explanation: The area along the edge of a river.

examples.japanese: {川辺|かわべ}を{散歩|さんぽ}した。
examples.english: I took a walk along the riverbank.

examples.japanese: {川辺|かわべ}に{座|すわ}って{弁当|べんとう}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I sat by the river and ate my lunch.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると、{川辺|かわべ}の{桜|さくら}が{一斉|いっせい}に{咲|さ}き、{花見|はなみ}を{楽|たの}しむ{人|ひと}でにぎわう。
examples.english: In spring, the cherry blossoms along the river bloom all at once, and the area bustles with people enjoying hanami.

notes:
Composed of {川|かわ} (river) + {辺|べ} (vicinity, edge). A simple, everyday word for the area beside a river. Also read as かわべり in some contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川辺|かわべ}を{歩|ある}く: to walk along the riverside
- {川辺|かわべ}に{座|すわ}る: to sit by the river
- {川辺|かわべ}の{風景|ふうけい}: riverside scenery
- {川辺|かわべ}の{公園|こうえん}: riverside park

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {川岸|かわぎし}: riverbank — focuses more on the bank/embankment itself
- {岸辺|きしべ}: shore, bank — broader, can be used for lakes and seas too
- {河川敷|かせんしき}: riverbed area — the flat area between the river and the levee
